dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Because my workplace is closer to where I live.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: My previous work was related to the courts, so I had to shuttle between the Palais Mermonia and the opera house. This location, on the other hand, is far more convenient.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I head over there to watch a performance — and what do you know, I do sometimes miss my previous workplaces when I see them.
